method: heap capability used=total-free; local peak=total-min from MEMORY STOP window; before/after_stop and budget/Surface peaks are cumulative. No JPEG in measured scopes. UI2 save/load includes its 2112-byte PERF recorder without deductions.

matched_cold_and_warm.method: Same final Host, no JPEG/PERF; 0.9 executable unchanged, 12-byte empty custom section restores old AOT source retention.

retention_proxy_proof.purpose: Original source-retention policy proxy; executable unchanged; empty custom section adds 12 bytes

limitations: Policy proxy adds 12 bytes to the original 0.9 AOT; executable/data/resources are unchanged, but it is not the untouched historical package or Host.

Matched normal cold SRAM steady sample is 36 bytes and local peak 76 bytes above old-policy cold; warm steady and whole-two-launch SRAM peak are equal. Cannot assert bytewise non-growth for every phase.
Twenty restart stop-state PSRAM varies by 1060 bytes, with higher last samples; platform background/cache contribution has not been isolated. This is not a long-duration no-leak proof.
UI2 is a separate debug build and second warm launch, not normal product memory.
